member.mail.buttonFallback: If the button does not work, open this address in your browser:
member.mail.ignore: If you did not make this request yourself, you can ignore this e-mail.
member.mail.login.subject: Check number {$digits} — confirm sign-in
member.mail.login.requested: A sign-in was requested for your account:
member.mail.login.compare: The screen on which you requested the sign-in shows the same check number. If the two numbers match, it is your sign-in.
member.mail.login.where: If the link opens in the same browser in which you requested the sign-in, you are signed in at once. If it opens elsewhere (on your phone, for instance), sign in there — or allow the sign-in on the other device.
member.mail.login.stranger: Then someone else started a sign-in with your e-mail address. Simply delete this e-mail — as long as you do not open and confirm the link, nothing happens.
member.mail.login.validity: The link is valid for 15 minutes and works exactly once.
member.mail.noAccount.subject: There is no account for this address
member.mail.noAccount.lead: A sign-in was just requested for this e-mail address — but there is no account for it.
member.mail.noAccount.register: If you would like to create an account, register here:
member.mail.confirm.subject: Please confirm your e-mail address
member.mail.confirm.lead: Thank you for registering. Please confirm your e-mail address using the following link:
member.mail.confirm.validity: The link is valid for 7 days. After confirmation we review your registration and activate your access — you will then receive another e-mail.
member.mail.confirm.ignore: If you did not register, ignore this e-mail — no account is created without this confirmation.
member.mail.existing.subject: You already have an account
member.mail.existing.lead: An account already exists for this e-mail address — there is no need to register again.
member.mail.existing.body: You can sign in as usual. If you did not make this request yourself, you can ignore this e-mail; nothing has been changed on your account.
member.mail.activated.subject: Your access has been activated
member.mail.activated.lead: Your access has been activated — you can sign in right away:
member.mail.joinActivated.subject: Your access to “{$tenant}” has been activated
member.mail.joinActivated.leadHtml: Your access to {$tenant} has been activated. Sign in as usual and choose at the top of the page which {$noun} you are working for — switching does not require a new sign-in.
member.mail.invite.subject: Invitation to “{$tenant}”
member.mail.invite.leadHtml: {$inviter} has invited you to work on {$tenant}.
member.mail.invite.known: An account already exists for your e-mail address. The following link adds “{$tenant}” to your account — your account, your sign-in and your devices stay as they are:
member.mail.invite.new: Use the following link to set up your access — you only need to enter your name; your e-mail address is already confirmed by this invitation:
member.mail.invite.validity: The link is valid for {$days} days and can be used only once. After you sign up we review the access and activate it — you will then receive another e-mail.
member.mail.invite.ignoreKnown: If you were not expecting this invitation, ignore this e-mail — without the link, nothing changes on your account.
member.mail.invite.ignoreNew: If you were not expecting this invitation, ignore this e-mail — without the link, no account is created.
member.lang.label: Language
member.login.title: Sign in
member.login.deleted: Your account has been deleted. Thank you for being with us.
member.login.lead: Enter your e-mail address — we will send you a sign-in link. There is no password.
member.wait.title: Sign-in requested
member.wait.lead: If there is an account for this address, an e-mail is on its way. You can open it here or on another device — on your phone, for instance.
member.wait.howto: This number is also in the e-mail — in the subject and in the text. If you open the link in this browser, you are signed in at once. If you open it on another device, allow the sign-in for this device there — it then signs in automatically. Keep this page open until then.
member.wait.otherHtml: If the e-mail shows a different number, it belongs to another sign-in — do not confirm it.
member.wait.repeatedHtml: You have already requested a link this hour. Check your spam folder — that is where the e-mail most often lands. What counts is the most recent e-mail: its link is valid, earlier ones are void. Do not request a new one — every further request invalidates the previous link.
member.wait.doneLead: The sign-in took place in another tab of this browser. You can close this tab.
member.wait.deadLead: This sign-in is no longer valid — it has expired or was already answered elsewhere.
member.redeem.confirmedLead: The device on which the sign-in was requested is signing in now — this takes a few seconds. You can close this window.
member.redeem.title: Confirm sign-in
member.redeem.elsewhere: This sign-in was requested in another browser or on another device:
member.redeem.warnHtml: Only allow the other device if it shows the same check number. If it shows none or a different one, someone else started the sign-in: do not allow it.
member.redeem.nobody: No device is waiting for a confirmation of this link any more — the request has expired or was already answered. You can still sign in here.
member.redeem.other: Allow the sign-in on the other device ({$device})
member.totp.title: Enter code
member.totp.lead: Your account is protected by two-factor authentication — enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
member.totp.lost: if your device is lost, we reset the protection for you.
member.totp.locked: Too many failed attempts — please wait 15 minutes.
member.totp.invalid: The code is invalid or has already been used — please wait for the next code.
member.logout.title: Sign out
member.logout.stale: Session expired: please confirm signing out.
member.login.deadLink: This sign-in link is no longer valid — request a new one.
member.login.expired: The sign-in has expired — request a new link.
member.totp.unavailable: Signing in with a code is currently not possible due to a technical problem. Please inform the operator.
member.form.remember: Stay signed in on this device
member.register.title: Register
member.register.lead: Create your account. You will then receive an e-mail with a confirmation link — only after that do we review your registration and activate your access.
member.invite.title: Accept invitation
member.invite.deadLead: This invitation has expired or was withdrawn.
member.invite.deadAside: Please contact the person who invited you — they can send you a new invitation.
member.invite.taken: Your e-mail address already belongs to this {$noun}. Simply sign in — this invitation is no longer needed.
member.invite.joinLeadHtml: You have been invited to work on {$tenant}. An account already exists for your address {$email} — it stays as it is. If you agree, {$tenant} is added to your account, and after signing in you choose whom you are working for.
member.invite.joinAside: We review the access and activate it; you will then receive an e-mail. You can give up the access at any time — whoever invited you can likewise pause or remove it.
member.invite.lead: You have been invited to work on an existing {$noun}. Just enter your name — your e-mail address is already confirmed by the invitation. We then review the access and activate it.
member.invite.addressFixed: It cannot be changed here — the invitation is valid for exactly this address.
member.thanks.title: Thank you
member.thanks.declined: Nothing has happened — your account is unchanged and the link in the invitation no longer works. If you change your mind, you can be invited again.
member.thanks.join: The access has been added to your account and is waiting for activation. You will receive an e-mail as soon as it is ready — after signing in, you then choose which {$noun} you are working for.
member.thanks.invite: Your access has been requested. Your e-mail address is already confirmed by the invitation — we review the access and activate it. You will receive an e-mail as soon as it is ready.
member.thanks.register: We have received your details and sent you an e-mail. Please follow the link in it.
member.thanks.noMail: No e-mail received? Check your spam folder or
member.resend.title: Request the link again
member.resend.lead: Enter your e-mail address — we will send you the confirmation link again.
member.resend.thanks: If there is an account for this address, we have just sent you an e-mail. Please also check your spam folder.
member.confirm.title: E-mail confirmed
member.confirm.lead: Thank you — your e-mail address is confirmed. We review your registration and activate your access. You will receive an e-mail as soon as it is ready.
member.confirm.already: This e-mail address is already confirmed — there is nothing more to do. You will receive an e-mail as soon as your access is activated.
member.confirm.dead: This confirmation link has expired or has already been used.
member.profile.tenantRefused: This {$noun} is not available to you.
member.profile.sessionExpired: Your session has expired — please sign in again.
member.profile.deleteUnconfirmed: Nothing deleted: to confirm, type your e-mail address exactly as shown above and tick the box.
member.profile.deleteRefused: Deletion not possible — nothing was removed: {$reason}
member.profile.deviceRemoved: The device is signed out — on its next visit it will ask for a new sign-in link.
member.profile.deviceUnknown: This device is not (or no longer) in the list.
member.profile.allRemoved: All devices are signed out — every access will ask for a sign-in link again.
member.profile.totpOn: Two-factor authentication is on — from now on, signing in asks for the app code.
member.profile.totpSetupWrong: The code is invalid — please scan the QR code and try again.
member.profile.totpSetupBroken: Two-factor authentication cannot be set up at the moment due to a technical problem. Please inform the operator.
member.profile.totpRemoveFailed: Removal failed — the app code is required, must be valid and must not have been used before.
member.profile.waiting: Your registration is confirmed and waiting for activation. You will receive an e-mail as soon as your access is active.
member.profile.closed: Your access to “{$tenant}” is not open at the moment.
member.profile.closedNote: Your access to “{$tenant}” is not open at the moment: {$note}.
member.profile.emailChange: We change the e-mail address together: it is your access, and moving it needs a confirmation through the new address. Write to us.
member.profile.companyHint: Where you work. This does not change the name of your {$noun} — its owner sets that.
member.profile.deleteLead: You can delete your account yourself — immediately and for good. Sign-in, signed-in devices and two-factor authentication end with it.
member.profile.deleteWhat: Your account, your signed-in devices and your two-factor authentication will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
member.profile.deleteCheck: I know that this cannot be undone.
member.profile.totpSince: On since {$date} — signing in also asks for the app code.
member.profile.totpRemoveCode: To remove: code from the app
member.profile.totpWithout: Without a second factor, your access depends on your mailbox alone.
member.profile.totpWhy: With an authenticator app, signing in asks for a 6-digit code in addition to the link. You need your phone for it — and setting it up once takes a minute.
member.profile.devicesEmpty: Tick “Stay signed in on this device” when signing in if you do not want to request a new link every time.
member.profile.devicesHint: Devices are counted per browser, not per computer: anyone who deletes their cookies, uses a private window or a second browser appears here as another device — even with the same name. A signed-out device asks for a new sign-in link on its next visit; at most five stay signed in, the one unused for longest gives way. Otherwise the entries expire by themselves after 90 days.
member.profile.name: Name
member.totpSetup.title: Set up two-factor authentication
member.totpSetup.lead: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app (e.g. Google Authenticator, Aegis, 2FAS) and confirm with the code shown.
member.totpSetup.qrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app
member.totpSetup.manual: Without a camera: enter the key by hand —
member.js.themeNotSaved: The view was not saved — please reload the page.
member.js.changeNotSaved: Change not saved — please reload the page.
